summary: Submitted a small additive feedback product at the run's time boundary, with preflight returning valid:true. It completes an explanation already on the record using an execution the run had already paid for: the earlier note said Stats publishes the cached last log while LastIndex() takes the greater of that cache and the last snapshot, and that the value was accurate because nothing had been compacted; the truncated-log execution of the commit-context requirement supplies the missing half, since that receiving node was configured with no trailing logs and the same pair still appeared - last index 43 and last snapshot index 43 beside a cached last log of index one and term one. The cached value is therefore not refreshed by adopting the snapshot in either configuration, so the explanation moves from 'nothing was removed' to 'the cached report is independent of the store's actual truncation'. No map object, check or evidence is claimed, and the commit-context obligation that execution was serving is unaffected. Remaining items restated briefly: whether any consumer depends on the cached last-log report rather than the effective one was not investigated; whether the two names warrant a documentation change is presentation, not an obligation; the repair locations for the eleven confirmed obligations are still open; no external consumer was exercised for the client-contract findings; the campaign path of a server without a vote is not fully read; the transfer path accepts a non-voter target and reported success with no leader established; and the deferred third-party-transport, MonotonicLogStore and nested-module surfaces remain unread. Run state: audit spec v13, all units checked, eleven confirmed in-scope obligations with executed and reviewed witnesses (two of them carrying a second scenario each), 2 audit units, 19 experiments and 9 semantic reviews unused, and about a minute remaining.
